changes: Version-bound recovery cleanup uses the actual stored-copy SHA-256, rejects changed copies and preserves the existing four-field disk format. Old projects need no migration.

A ten-second cleanup deadline separates confirmed manuscript saves from unconfirmed backup maintenance. Late callbacks compare current project/path/load/content and local-cache identity; they cannot clear newer recovery data or replay manuscript writes.

Rejected retries retain earlier unconfirmed/conflicting save state, dirty/navigation guards and explicitly authorized manual recovery. WORKSPACE_BUSY is no longer newly mislabeled as a disk revision conflict.

Recovery actions are hidden during chapter reads and guarded against concurrent read/save ownership. Author discard waits for real receipt; changed copies stay pending until explicitly reread and reviewed.
26 current isolated headless cases passed (nine recovery flows and 17 affected existing regressions), 15 real local recovery-API tests and 56 local-transport adapter assertions. No AI requests.

Local Preview / PARTIAL: native desktop/physical IME/DPI/voice/cloud AI not newly verified; an isolated Windows Proactor service shutdown remains under investigation. No dependencies, schema migration, user-data move, global Codex edit, shortcut update, Git commit/push or publication. Public 2.24.26 remains unchanged.
runtime_validation: Preview / PARTIAL: see the current delivery evidence; headless browser, local checks, real Codex/MCP and packaged workers are separate gates. No native GUI/IME/DPI acceptance is claimed.
features: Character assistants, Python SDK and Codex MCP reuse one typed Action Registry and existing domain services.
On-demand Python Control uses genuine CPython WASI in a bounded owned subprocess, without host project mounts, network or shell.
Real frontend receipts support chapter navigation, pinned references, layouts and actual editor state.
Project/persona-scoped scripts, output history, AI task provenance and explicit read-only result handoffs.
Existing Codex login, concrete models and supported effort/context controls; real task events, result reading, cancellation and supported live steering.
Frozen author confirmations remain valid after a model or Python turn ends; scripts are never automatically replayed.
Source and binary candidates exclude private manuscripts, credentials, conversation history and character assets.
Preview: the action catalog covers designated workflows, not every application operation; new controls primarily support Chinese and English.
